# Bundled visual assets

28 original furniture/prop models plus the rover: DYNORA, MIT (project LICENSE). Geometry source: src/visual-models.js and src/room-models.js. Previews render the actual GLBs.

PBR textures by Lennart Demes / ambientCG, CC0 1.0. Raw texture files may be redistributed. License: https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/

- Wood Floor 051 — https://ambientcg.com/a/WoodFloor051 — 1K JPG color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; metalness where supplied.
- Painted Plaster 017 — https://ambientcg.com/a/PaintedPlaster017 — 1K JPG color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; metalness where supplied.
- Fabric 030 — https://ambientcg.com/a/Fabric030 — 1K JPG color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; metalness where supplied.
- Metal 032 — https://ambientcg.com/a/Metal032 — 1K JPG color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; metalness where supplied.
- Tiles 107 — https://ambientcg.com/a/Tiles107 — 1K JPG color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; metalness where supplied.

Studio Small 09 HDRI by Poly Haven, CC0 1.0. https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_09 . License: https://polyhaven.com/license . Powered by Poly Haven (build-time API discovery only; no runtime API requests).
